amendments.existing: ux_user_mfa_factor__user_live UNIQUE (user_id, factor_type) WHERE status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE') AND is_deleted = false.
amendments.proposed: Key the index on (user_id, factor_type, status) with the same predicate: at most one PENDING and one ACTIVE factor per user and type. Path C may never replace an ACTIVE factor; any confirmation ends every other open enrollment transaction and link (IR-20).
amendments.reason: The certified key contradicts 05 §11.5 and TD-E, which keep the current factor ACTIVE while a replacement is PENDING.
amendments.security: None negative: one ACTIVE factor; a PENDING factor never authenticates. IR-20 closes the replacement-without-step-up path.
amendments.data: Index key only (0004_auth); no column change.
amendments.rollback: Restore the two-column key; needs a different TD-E design first.

amendments.proposed: When MFA is required: 200 {status: MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED, invite_context, expires_in}. The context is an INVITE_CONTEXT enrollment challenge: single-use, 15 min, one live per invitee (a resend or repeated acceptance supersedes earlier ones), confirmable only through PATH_B without a bearer. Acknowledge that path B's second proof (the new password) is chosen by whoever holds the link.
amendments.reason: A 204 cannot carry the enrollment continuation required by 05 §11.3 path B.
amendments.security: Two out-of-band proofs; no session before confirmation; binding per AM-11.
amendments.rollback: None without an alternative path-B design.

amendments.existing: Login body {email, password}; no CAPTCHA field or signal.
amendments.proposed: Optional turnstile_token (≤ 2048) on login; 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS carries captcha_required; MFA 401s carry attempts_remaining. Verification runs outside the write lock (IR-02); networks are parsed /24 and /64 (IR-22); the development verifier exists only in local/test (IR-09).
amendments.reason: 05 §4 cannot be implemented with the closed 08 §4.1 schema.
amendments.security: Implements the certified control; uniform responses kept.
amendments.ui: Login shows the widget when required.
amendments.rollback: Remove the field; throttling falls back to the delay only.

amendments.existing: 04 §5.4: re-consent 'through PATCH of the consent_* fields'; 08 §8.5: consent_* → 422 FIELD_NOT_UPDATABLE. The two conflict.
amendments.proposed: PATCH /leads/{id} accepts consent {channel ∈ PHONE_VERBAL|IN_PERSON|WHATSAPP|EMAIL, policy_version, note}; raw consent_* stay FIELD_NOT_UPDATABLE. Accepted only after withdrawal, when never captured, or for a new published notice version. The superseded evidence is first written to a read-only system activity (consent_evidence, visible in the lead timeline) and remains in audit_log; the new capture has no web IP or source page. Decision requested: keep this in-row + timeline model, or add a dedicated append-only lead_consent_event table.
amendments.reason: Resolves the certified conflict and the IR-16 defects without an unapproved schema change.
amendments.security: Requires lead.update in scope and If-Match; provenance no longer mixed.
amendments.data: No schema change; one system activity per re-consent.
amendments.api: consent object on PATCH; additive read-only consent_evidence on activities.
amendments.ui: Timeline shows the superseded evidence; no re-consent control in P0 (09 specifies none).
amendments.rollback: Remove the consent field; re-consent then cannot be recorded.

amendments.existing: 06 §7.5 step 5 requires a signed cancel link; no endpoint or page is named; RBX-003 does not list one.
amendments.proposed: Add POST /api/v1/approvals/cancel-link {token} (RBX-003, public) to the 08 index and the RBX-003 register, and a public SPA page /approvals/cancel that cancels only after an explicit confirmation. Retention of outbox_event must exceed the break-glass window (the link binding relies on those rows, IR-A10).
amendments.security: 256-bit HMAC token, hash stored, single use, sibling links invalidated, uniform 400.
tests: app/e2e/access.e2e.mjs: break-glass cancel link works end to end from the email
amendments.rollback: Remove the endpoint and page; the veto becomes unusable again.

amendments.existing: /health/ready: 'migrations at head'; body shows checks publicly.
amendments.proposed: Readiness: head → ready; known older revision → not ready; revision unknown to the image → ready only if the operator declared it expand-only compatible (VEDA_SCHEMA_AHEAD_ACCEPTED, set by the N-1 rollback runbook); otherwise not ready. Check details only to direct local callers; the edge gets {status}.
amendments.reason: The normal rollback (N-1 image on a migrated schema) must be able to pass readiness.
amendments.api: Readiness body at the edge is {status} only.
amendments.compat: Deploy gate on the host keeps the full body.
amendments.rollback: Revert to strict head equality (rollback path then requires snapshot restore).

amendments.existing: POST /auth/login 5/min per email; POST /auth/password/forgot 3/hour per email.
amendments.proposed: Key both per-email limits on (email, client network /24 or /64).
amendments.reason: A third party must not be able to lock an account holder out from every network.
amendments.security: Distributed guessing is still bounded by the per-account throttles of 05 §4.

amendments.existing: Action tokens are described as random single-use tokens with only a hash stored.
amendments.proposed: Document that raw tokens are HMAC(K_action, row id ‖ purpose) so the worker can rebuild links without storing secrets; a K_action compromise together with row ids yields every live link; rotating K_action invalidates all open links.

amendments.existing: Any notified party can cancel a break-glass request through its link.
amendments.proposed: Owner decision required: a hostile sole Founder can cancel custodian break-glass repeatedly. Options: accept, cap cancellations per window, or require the custodians' re-request to be uncancellable by the target.

amendments.existing: pii_fields omit several free-text fields; IP and user agent stay in audit_log/security_event_log after erasure.
amendments.proposed: Owner decision: extend pii_fields (consent notes, loss reasons, activity text, the new consent_evidence) and decide IP/user-agent retention after erasure.

amendments.existing: mfa_challenge: user_id, purpose, token_hash, session_id, expires_on, failed_attempts, completed_on, ip_address.
amendments.proposed: Add nullable factor_id (FK user_mfa_factor, RESTRICT) and enrollment_path ∈ {INVITE_CONTEXT, PATH_A, PATH_B, PATH_C, PATH_D} with CHECKs: path only on ENROLLMENT challenges; factor only on confirmable paths. Migration 0009_mfa_challenge_binding (expand-only; N-1 rows carry NULLs and are refused by the N image).
amendments.reason: Binding the transaction to its factor and path from server state is the reviewer's IR-01 remediation.
amendments.security: Closes the confusion class of IR-01.
amendments.data: Two nullable columns; no data rewrite; purge order unchanged (challenges first).
amendments.compat: Expand-only; an enrollment started just before the upgrade must be restarted.
tests: api/tests/integration/test_schema.py (conformance, migration order, upgrade with data)
amendments.rollback: Normal rollback: N-1 image on the migrated schema (columns ignored). Removing the columns is a later contract step.
